value.body: Coach posts with the Sports Authority of India (SAI), state sports departments, and sports schools and hostels run by states. Coaches train athletes in one sport at training centres, academies and hostels. Some posts are regular; many are contract positions.

items.label: Who recruits
items.value: SAI, state sports departments, state PSCs or staff boards

items.label: Typical requirement
items.value: Coaching diploma or physical education degree, plus a playing record in the sport
items.note: Exact rules differ by recruiter and post

items.label: SAI Assistant Coach vacancies (2026 notice)
items.source: SAI Assistant Coach notification dated 15.01.2026 (as reported)

items.label: Vacant posts across SAI
items.note: All SAI posts, not only coaches
items.source: Lok Sabha reply, Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports (as reported)

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Apply when SAI or a state notifies coach posts. Selection usually looks at your coaching qualification and sports record, and may include a written test, skill test or interview.

value.title: At a glance
items: Recruitment is irregular and the number of posts is small.
Contract posts are common, and renewal depends on the scheme.
A recognised coaching qualification is usually required.
